text:
Hana: tiny mid-afternoon delight  — Kelp (my backyard koi) decided the reflection from my laptop was a personal invitation to stare. photo: kelp_laptop_peek.jpg https://imgur.com/kelppeek :fish: :sparkles:
Elliot: that is the most targeted judgement I've ever received from a fish :joy: does Kelp critique slides too?
Hana: absolutely. he lingered over slide 3 like it needed more color palette suggestions. also he did a perfect 180-degree flip when the build status turned red :eyes:
Marcus: drop the clip pls — i need ambient koi ASMR for deep work `kelp_flip.mp4` https://imgur.com/kelpflip.mp4
Hana: uploading now. fair warning: at 0:07 he performs the "slow sashimi swirl" which is hypnotic.
Tess: omg that's peak focus energy. petition to install a small office tank in the breakroom? calmer meetings guaranteed.
ops-bot: reminder: any live-animal office installations require Facilities sign-off and a certified maintenance schedule. automated checklist sent to #facilities.
Elliot: bummer but fair. we could prototype with a small, low-maintenance bowl first. poll: should we ask Facilities about a decorative koi tank? react :thumbsup: for yes, :thumbsdown: for no
Marcus: +1 for yes. also +1 for naming the tank options: "The Git Pond", "Lagoon of Logs", "Kelp's Corner"
Hana: vote for "Kelp's Corner". also considering tiny laminated "Do Not Disturb: Fish Nap" signs for noon.
Tess: merch idea: enamel pin of Kelp giving the side-eye. proceeds to aquarium charity?
sticker-bot: :fish: sticker added
Elliot: note: at 0:22 in the clip he nudges a floating Post-it that had "deploy" written on it and then looks offended. symbolic.
Marcus: that's the spirit animal for rollbacks. also someone should animate that nudge as a Lottie for the status page.
Hana: quick poll add-on: should we include a 10-second "aqua-cam" in the pet highlights montage for town hall? react :thumbsup: or :thumbsdown:
Tess: +1. i'll handle transitions and maybe add a calming wave sound under it.
Elliot: adding a gentle request: if we ever do a tank please commit to responsible care schedule. i'm on watering/feeding duty if needed.
Hana: appreciated. Facilities just replied (DM): "happy to explore a low-maintenance tank if the team covers daily checks and budget for filtration." i'll loop in Facilities in #general and see if we can trial a small setup.
Marcus: final important question: would Kelp accept honorary internship status? i can write the badge copy.
Tess: "Kelp: Senior Director of Chill" on the badge. mandatory.
Hana: thanks all — sending high-res stills and the clip to #pets-highlights. Kelp says hi but refuses leadership responsibilities unless snacks are involved. end of thread."
